brief: An herb amphitheatre for a kitchen window: three staggered rows of three planters stepping up one, two and three storeys from front to back, so every plant faces the viewer at the low side. Front row: thyme, oregano and alyssum. Middle row: basil, parsley and chives. Back row: rosemary, sage and mint. Fill every planter with soil and plant it. Put the one-storey row nearest the default view and the tall row farthest from it, and use look to check that every plant is visible from that view.

A desk organiser: two two-storey columns at the back and three one-storey cells in front of them, the viewer at the front. Back row: the left column with an open bin on its top storey holding a pencil cup; the right column capped with a cover carrying a coiled cable. Front row, left to right: a half cell with a drawer that opens toward the viewer, a full cell with a cover carrying a phone, and a full cell with a cover carrying a mug with a pen standing in it. Use look to check that the drawer faces the view and every prop is visible.

A filament wall: four two-storey columns in a row with a one-cell gap between neighbours, rod sockets facing each gap and an axle across each of the three gaps with a filament spool hung on it, covers on every column with a hex driver set standing on the right-hand one, and a half cell in front of the left-hand column with a drawer that opens toward the viewer. Use look to check that the spools and the drawer face the view.

A planter tower for a patio: one planter three storeys tall in the middle, ringed by six planters two storeys tall, with a crescent of five one-storey planters hugging the front of the ring on the side nearest the default view, so the whole build steps up one, two and three storeys away from the viewer. All bins radial-drain. Behind the ring, three one-storey cells with covers make a potting shelf: one small nursery pot on each cover, each filled with soil and planted with a seedling. Fill every planter with soil and plant it: a patio tomato in the middle; butterhead lettuce, oakleaf lettuce, parsley, basil, chives and a marigold around the ring; nasturtium, alyssum, strawberry, thyme and oregano along the crescent. Use look to check that every plant is visible from the default view.
